narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A Rose bill, black-letter, brought across and not a thing you stood in front of. The title is the whole of the printed line you read. No author. No price. The bill, on the bookwheel. The same bill. The margin where a receipt would be written is blank.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and did not cross to the Rose.

entities.name: a second part of Caesar
entities.context: Shown on bill in A second part of Caesar
